content:
sasha_cs: Heads-up: Auriga preview cohort kickoff next Wed. Need final enrollments + 1-line use case + top risk per account by Mon EOD. Put details in https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/auriga-enroll (please don't change header row).

ben_csm: Uploading my list now. Two accounts asked for SSO, one asked for IP allowlist and stricter retention (14d).

mike_eng: For retention we can set workspace TTL to 14d but need to know which logs/traces to exclude. For SSO we need IdP metadata (ACS, EntityID, cert).

tara_enable: I'll run a 20-min enablement slot during each kickoff to walk admins through SSO and retention settings. Can someone capture preferred trace windows and 3 canonical prompts per customer?

sasha_cs: Added columns: success_metric, trial_blocker, preferred_trace_window, prompts_required, ok_to_share_notes. Fill by Mon EOD.

billing_ops: Quick billing note: token-level debug traces will generate extra billing. Recommend limiting to 12h per account. If a customer requests >24h, we need exec sign-off and a cost estimate.

ben_csm: Noted. I'll capture trace windows and mark any procurement delays under trial_blocker. One account is procurement_pending ~4-6 weeks.

mike_eng: For IP allowlists we need CIDR + expected RPS. If sustained RPS >75, infra requests reserved capacity.

tara_enable: I'll draft the Day7 3-question survey and a Day14 interview guide and drop them in the enablement drive by Friday.

sasha_cs: Rollout checklist (short):
- Confirm enroll list (CS)
- Capture IdP metadata + CIDR + RPS + prompts (CS)
- Assign trace windows (CS + Eng)
- Enablement admin slot + survey (Enablement)
- Eval harness prep + trace export runbook (Eng)
- Risk flags + mitigation + billing sign-off if >24h traces (CS/Billing)

ben_csm: I'll also add a "close_loop" column to track resolution of blockers.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Auriga enroll list due" on 2025-09-15 17:00 UTC.

sasha_cs: Thanks—if anything blocks collecting IdP metadata or prompts, DM me. I'll compile the sanitized kickoff notes after the meeting.
